meta.title: ANATOMICA nervous system inventory — Milestone 9
meta.source_tables: data/sources/bodyparts3d-4.0/ (BP3D 4.0 / FMA concept ids and names as released)
meta.counting_convention: One record per lateralised instance where the tables lateralise (right/left as separate records, mirroring the skeletal, muscular and cardiovascular modules); one record for an un-sided class modelled jointly; a lateralised concept whose side-stripped class does not exist in the release is one record keyed on the concept itself. The brain and spinal cord are records keyed on their PART-OF-only organ concepts; named brain parts existing only in the PART-OF tree are records keyed on PART-OF concepts; specific IS-A neuraxis structures and the peripheral nerves/ganglion are records keyed on IS-A concepts. Structural roots, tree classes, generic part classes ('... of neuraxis'), segment/zone/region/subdivision classes, nerve branch-of classes, ventricular-system and cortical aggregate concepts are not records.
